test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** The correct answer is I**rreligous.**

correct spelling is Irreligious which means ***having no religious beliefs.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Rebellious means **not doing what authority, society, etc. wants you to do**
 
• Irrelevant means **not connected with something or important to it**
 
• Irritating means **to make somebody angry; to annoy.**

Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
